title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.


2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.

2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior data engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties

Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries; Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic; Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting; Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases; Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills

Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing); Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures); Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools; Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills

Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob); Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation; Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Médico endocrinologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico endocrinologista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia. Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Cloud windows infrastructure engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud windows infrastructure engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer

Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, Power Shell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.

The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.

This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.

Role Responsibilities

Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain Power Shell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, Cloud Watch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.

Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSo P, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced Power Shell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: Perf Mon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

Hybrid identity: AD on-prem cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage. On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.

Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.

Offer Details:

Duration of Contract: 12 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)

Key Qualifications:

Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Additional Details:

Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 12 months

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.

This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.

About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.

Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.

Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.

Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.

The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.

Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.

Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership

Conditions

• 12 month B2 B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level

The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.

Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.

This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.

About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.

Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.

Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.

Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.

The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.

Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.

Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership

Conditions

• 12 month B2 B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level

The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.

Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

title: Business specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.

2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal

.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces

s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci

es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir

ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.

This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.

About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.

Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.

Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.

Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.

The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.

Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.

Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership

Conditions

• 12 month B2 B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level

The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.

Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

title: Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ml engineer | fully remote | b2b em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.

This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.

About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2 B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.

Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, Dev Ops and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.

Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product.

Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.

The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, Sage Maker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and Type Script.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.

Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, Sage Maker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows

This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.

Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, No SQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership

Conditions

• 12 month B2 B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level

The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.

Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

title: Senior treasury analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior treasury analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.

The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)

• Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.

• Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.

• Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.

• Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.

• Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.

• Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.

• Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.

• Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.

• Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.

• Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.

• Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.

Cash Management & Treasury Operations

• Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.

• Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.

• Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.

• Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.

• Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.

• Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.

• Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.

• Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.

• Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.

• Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.

• Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization.

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.

• Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

• Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.

• Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.

• Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.

• Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.

• Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Languages

• Advanced English (required).

• Intermediate Spanish (desirable).

Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Linux systems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux systems engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer

Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure

DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux

SENIORITY: Mid · Senior

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years

STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit

01 About the role

We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.

02 What you'll own

Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.

03 What you bring

MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE

3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.

NICE BONUS SIGNAL

Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot.

04 The kind of engineer this work asks for

Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for

APPLY

Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Senior machine learning engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior machine learning engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2 B platform for hospitality. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.

What you'll do

Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we're looking for

We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, Py Torch/Tensor Flow).

Nice to have (not required)

Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., Sage Maker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente
