title: Linux systems engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Linux systems engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Linux Systems Engineer

Embedded, Io T & Edge Infrastructure

DISCIPLINE: Embedded Linux

SENIORITY: Mid · Senior

EXPERIENCE: 3+ years

STACK FOCUS: Yocto · Web Kit

01 About the role

We're looking for a Linux engineer with an investigative mindset and a solid foundation in embedded systems. Short term: take hardware from third-party signage vendors, understand what's running on it, adapt our player to run reliably on top. Longer term: build our own Yocto-based image from scratch — you'll be shaping that foundation too.

02 What you'll own

Reverse engineer OS images from signage vendors — boot, drivers, app stack. Port our signage player across hardware targets (ARM, x86). Integrate OTA frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partition schemes. Build embedded Linux images (Yocto/OE) as we move to our own OS. Tune GPU drivers for smooth video and graphics on signage hardware. Web Kit-based rendering (WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK) as primary runtime. Document ndings — BSP quirks, BIOS/UEFI behavior, integration procedures. Partner with the app team on player requirements and OS constraints.

03 What you bring

MUST NON-NEGOTIABLE

3+ years with embedded or edge Linux. Linux boot process — BIOS/UEFI, U-Boot/GRUB, initrd, device tree. Yocto or Buildroot. OTA / update frameworks — SWUpdate, RAUC, A/B partitions. GPU driver integration — Mesa, Intel, AMD, ARM Mali/Vivante. Reverse engineering mindset — analyze and document an unfamiliar OS image. Shell, C/C++, Git. Comfortable with real hardware, not just VMs.

NICE BONUS SIGNAL

Web Kit on embedded — WPE Web Kit, Web Kit GTK. Wayland / DRM-KMS display stack. Commercial signage hardware — LG web OS, Samsung Tizen, Bright Sign. Docker, CI/CD pipelines. Firmware analysis — binwalk, Ghidra. Rust or Python. Networking — bridge, vlan, iptables, m DNS. Security hardening / secure boot.

04 The kind of engineer this work asks for

Thinks like an investigator. Given an unknown device, knows where to pull threads. Documents findings, not just fixes. Leaves a trail for the team. Comfortable with ambiguity. At ease with projects still taking shape. Likes making things run cleanly. On hardware they weren't designed for

APPLY

Process run by a specialized technical consultancy. Candidates evaluated by engineers — real conversations, real hardware.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.

What You Will Do-

High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.

The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.

Core Traits (Soft Skills):

The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.

What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.

The Challenges You Will Face:

100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Senior software engineer (full stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer (full stack) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (Long-Term)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a kind, curious, and highly collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building exceptional user experiences.

This team is responsible for creating seamless and compelling digital experiences that make it easy for customers to engage with a premium e-commerce and consignment platform. The engineering culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, individual growth, and professional development.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be both a hands-on technical contributor and a key influencer in shaping engineering direction. You will lead and contribute to significant initiatives, mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and pair programming, and help drive the evolution of a modern technology platform.

This opportunity is ideal for engineers passionate about luxury retail, e-commerce, sustainability, and circular economy business models.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, performant, and testable software solutions. Build and enhance customer-facing applications that directly support strategic business initiatives. Contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions that shape the future of the platform. Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver impactful features. Review pull requests and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to teammates. Participate in pair programming and knowledge-sharing activities across the team. Deploy production-ready code and support applications throughout the software development lifecycle. Continuously learn and explore new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices.

Technology Stack

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including:

Java Kotlin Java Script Type Script Graph QL Kafka AWS Lambda Postgre SQL Dynamo DB

Legacy services currently include:

Ruby on Rails Elixir React

Required Experience & Skills

7+ years of professional software development experience. Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin, along with experience working in Ruby on Rails environments. Expertise in modern Java Script (ECMAScript), HTML, and CSS. Experience building applications with React and related ecosystem tools, including Node.js and npm. Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, Type Script, IDEs, version control systems, and deployment tools. Understanding of event-driven architectures, Graph QL, and database design fundamentals. Strong problem-solving skills and a user-centric engineering mindset. Interest in retail, e-commerce, luxury consignment, sustainability, or circular economy business models.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience implementing or maintaining Kafka-based event streaming solutions. Experience working with Elixir. Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices. Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.

What Makes You Successful

You are curious, adaptable, and continuously seek opportunities to learn. You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy mentoring fellow engineers. You balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making. You care deeply about delivering value to users through technology. You are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization focused on sustainability and premium resale experiences.

title: Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico nefrologista em telemedicina (com rqe) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado); Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. By Day 60

Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

title: Latam decom project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Latam decom project manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp's diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company's mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

About the Role

The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.

Vendor & MSP Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.

Delivery Governance & Compliance

Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).

Reporting & Metrics

Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.

Qualifications

8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.

Preferred Skills

PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.

Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at.

These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full stack engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (. NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month

We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2 B Saa S business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.

The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical Saa S platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.

The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.

The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

Full-stack development;. NET 10 / ASP. NET Core on the backend, Angular / Type Script on the front Real-time application development using Signal R Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor) CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern Dev Ops practices Multi-tenant white-label Saa S architecture Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction

This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.

What We're Looking For

5+ years of commercial software engineering experience Strong. NET / ASP. NET Core and Angular / Type Script skills Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems Cloud-native development on Azure Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding Postgre SQL or equivalent relational database experience Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant Saa S, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.

Why This Role

Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)

If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil)

Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership)

Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)

Role Overview

We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.

What You Will Do-

High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.

The DNA We Are Looking For-

The Baseline (Hard Skills):

Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.

Core Traits (Soft Skills):

The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.

What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face

What You Will Get:

Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.

The Challenges You Will Face:

100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional study director, latam em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.

Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action

Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

title: Cloud windows infrastructure engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud windows infrastructure engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cloud Windows Infrastructure Engineer

Job Purpose

As Senior Windows Infrastructure Engineer, you are the technical anchor for the Windows estate that powers the managed services platform — a multi-client environment hosted on AWS. The work is grounded in deep Windows Server operations: Active Directory, IIS, hybrid identity, Group Policy, Power Shell, certificate services, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

AWS is the platform on which all of this runs. Comfort with the cloud layer matters and you will operate it daily, but it is the Microsoft stack — and its operational nuance — that defines this role. We hire for deep Windows expertise first; the cloud layer is something a strong sysadmin can absorb.

The estate is Windows Server 2019 and above, end-to-end. Linux footprint is negligible — this is a role for someone who wants to go deep on the Microsoft stack rather than be spread thin across platforms.

This is a 100% individual contributor role. You will not manage or lead a team. You will own complex incidents end-to-end, set technical standards by example, and act as the senior escalation point for the Cloud Support function.

Role Responsibilities

Lead resolution of complex Windows Server incidents across multi-client, AWS-hosted environments — from triage to root cause to remediation. Administer and harden Windows Server 2019/2022/2025: Active Directory (forest/domain design, replication, FSMO, GPOs, trusts), DNS, DHCP, IIS, WSUS, AD CS, file & print services. Operate hybrid identity: AD on-prem AWS Managed Microsoft AD, federation with Entra ID (Azure AD) / AD FS, SAML / OIDC / OAuth, Kerberos, MFA. Author and maintain Power Shell automation: bulk administration, scheduled tasks, configuration drift correction, reporting, and DSC where appropriate. Operate the AWS hosting layer for Windows workloads: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command), Backup, Directory Service. Manage IIS in depth: sites, application pools, bindings, ARR / URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, and performance tuning. Drive observability of the Windows estate: event log strategy, performance baselines, Cloud Watch metrics & alarms, Grafana dashboards. Author runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles to codify operational standards. Participate in ITIL incident, problem, and change management; act as senior on-call escalation.

Essential Skills & Experience

Windows Server & Microsoft Infrastructure (Primary)

7+ years operating Windows Server in production, with deep hands-on experience on Windows Server 2019 and above. Active Directory at depth: forest/domain design, replication, FSMO roles, trusts, sites & services, schema, tombstone & recovery. Group Policy at scale: design, troubleshooting (RSo P, gpresult), security baselines, WMI filtering. IIS at depth: site & app pool configuration, ARR, URL Rewrite, SSL/TLS, failed request tracing, performance tuning. DNS, DHCP, WSUS, and Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) — real operational experience. Advanced Power Shell: scripting, modules, remoting, error handling, automation patterns, DSC familiarity. Windows patching at scale: planning, deployment, rollback, and troubleshooting in regulated environments. Windows performance troubleshooting: Perf Mon, ETW, memory dump analysis, IIS request diagnostics.

Identity & Authentication

Hybrid identity: AD on-prem cloud, Entra ID (Azure AD) Connect / federation, AD FS. SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, Kerberos, LDAP, MFA — practical implementation and troubleshooting. Certificate management and PKI in enterprise Windows environments.

AWS Hosting Platform (Operational Competence)

Day-to-day comfort operating Windows workloads in AWS: EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, Cloud Watch. AWS Systems Manager for Windows fleet management: Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command, State Manager, Parameter Store. AWS Directory Service / Managed Microsoft AD / AD Connector.

Note: Deep AWS architect-level expertise is not required. We hire for Windows depth; the cloud layer is the platform, and we expect strong fundamentals plus willingness to grow.

Service Operations & Remote Working

Strong ITIL grounding: incident, problem, change, and service lifecycle management. Prior experience in an MSP or shared-services environment — multiple client estates managed under SLA. Advanced / fluent professional English, written and spoken. Reliable, distraction-free home office with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video setup. Ability to work New York-aligned hours consistently, with the same presence and responsiveness as an office-based colleague.

Working Hours, Remote Setup & Engagement

This role is 100% remote and 100% individual contributor. To match the responsiveness of an office-based engineer:

Working hours: You will operate aligned to New York business hours (08:30–17:30 ET). Typical Brazil hours: 09:30–18:30 BRT during EDT (US summer) and 10:30–19:30 BRT during EST (US winter). You must be online, responsive, and actively engaged throughout core hours, the same as if you were sat with the team in the office. Home office: Quiet, ergonomic workspace with stable broadband (100 Mbps+ recommended), reliable power, and a professional video / audio setup. This is not a digital-nomad role. Engagement model: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) or via Employer of Record — confirmed during recruitment. Tax, invoicing, and benefits arrangements discussed at offer stage. Equipment & expenses: Discussed at offer stage. On-call: Participation in a senior escalation rota for major incidents — compensated in line with policy.

title: Senior software engineer (full stack)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior software engineer (full stack) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (Long-Term)

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a kind, curious, and highly collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building exceptional user experiences.

This team is responsible for creating seamless and compelling digital experiences that make it easy for customers to engage with a premium e-commerce and consignment platform. The engineering culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, individual growth, and professional development.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be both a hands-on technical contributor and a key influencer in shaping engineering direction. You will lead and contribute to significant initiatives, mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and pair programming, and help drive the evolution of a modern technology platform.

This opportunity is ideal for engineers passionate about luxury retail, e-commerce, sustainability, and circular economy business models.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, performant, and testable software solutions. Build and enhance customer-facing applications that directly support strategic business initiatives. Contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions that shape the future of the platform. Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver impactful features. Review pull requests and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to teammates. Participate in pair programming and knowledge-sharing activities across the team. Deploy production-ready code and support applications throughout the software development lifecycle. Continuously learn and explore new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices.

Technology Stack

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including:

Java Kotlin Java Script Type Script Graph QL Kafka AWS Lambda Postgre SQL Dynamo DB

Legacy services currently include:

Ruby on Rails Elixir React

Required Experience & Skills

7+ years of professional software development experience. Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin, along with experience working in Ruby on Rails environments. Expertise in modern Java Script (ECMAScript), HTML, and CSS. Experience building applications with React and related ecosystem tools, including Node.js and npm. Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, Type Script, IDEs, version control systems, and deployment tools. Understanding of event-driven architectures, Graph QL, and database design fundamentals. Strong problem-solving skills and a user-centric engineering mindset. Interest in retail, e-commerce, luxury consignment, sustainability, or circular economy business models.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience implementing or maintaining Kafka-based event streaming solutions. Experience working with Elixir. Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices. Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.

What Makes You Successful

You are curious, adaptable, and continuously seek opportunities to learn. You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy mentoring fellow engineers. You balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making. You care deeply about delivering value to users through technology. You are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization focused on sustainability and premium resale experiences.

Num primeiro momento o profissional estará sob supervisão para garantir o entendimento e fluxo de funcionamento do estúdio, mas com o passar do tempo a idéia é ganhar autonomia para realizar as tarefas mais cotidianas e recorrentes sem muita supervisão.

Experiência comprovada no segmento impresso e em todos os detalhes que o meio exige (marcas de corte, sangría, margens de segurança, dobras, vinco, cores CMYK, facas especiais, e fichas técnicas); Graduação em Design Gráfico, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Ter atuado ativamente com fechamento de arquivos, arte-final e preparação de arquivos para impressão. Conhecimento em softwares de gestão de tarefas como Monday ou Trello (aqui utilizamos Work Front);

title: Senior ai software engineer (.net + agentic workflows)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ai software engineer (.net + agentic workflows) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

QAT Global, a 30+ years IT consulting firm headquartered in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Software Engineer with strong. NET and Azure expertise and hands-on experience building AI-powered engineering workflows.

This position will work directly with US-based customers and distributed engineering teams across the US, Brazil, and Costa Rica.

About the Role

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both software engineering and applied AI domains — building automation while also validating and improving generated outputs.

This is an international environment, and the position is collaborative and technically strong.

Key Responsibilities

Design and maintain AI-assisted development workflows for. NET applications Build integrations between LLMs, internal tooling, and engineering platforms Create and refine prompts, templates, structured outputs, and agent behaviors Review, validate, and improve AI-generated. NET code and pull requests Develop automation around Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling Build evaluation and verification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns Debug and optimize agent execution flows, tooling integrations, and orchestration logic Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency

Required Qualifications

Strong experience with C# and. NET Core Strong experience with SQL and Entity Framework Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc. Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure Dev Ops Ability to read and interpret technical and architectural documentation Hands-on experience working with modern LLM platforms such as Open AI, Claude, or similar Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow design Familiarity with at least one modern AI/agent framework, such as Semantic Kernel, Lang Graph, Auto Gen, Claude Agent SDK, and similar frameworks Strong problem-solving and debugging skills Advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

Experience with developer tooling or engineering automation AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) Experience with vector databases or RAG architectures Observability or evaluation frameworks for AI systems Experience with Blazor or legacy. NET Framework applications Exposure to prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, or LLM testing strategies

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who:

enjoy solving complex technical problems; are comfortable working with emerging AI technologies; can balance engineering quality with experimentation; have a hands-on mindset; can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Business development representative (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business development representative (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.

O que você vai fazer aqui?

Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e Linked In, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos. Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença. Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas. Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar. Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo.

O que buscamos?

Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou Saa S. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real. Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente. Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico. Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar. Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos.

Pontos extra se...

Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou Saa S B2 B para o mercado mid-market. Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como Hub Spot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.). Fala espanhol.

O que oferecemos?

Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta. Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva. Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

Olá, somos a Super Frete :)

Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

title: Data annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data annotator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

We're excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network, and we're looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling).

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation, this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team.

Location: Brazil, Language: Portuguese

Key Responsibilities

Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material). Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality. Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems. Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.

Requirements

Minimum qualification: High School completed or pursuing Bachelors. Strong command of English (written and verbal). Excellent analytical and communication skills. Comfortable working with diverse content types. Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet.

If you're detail-oriented, tech-curious, and eager to contribute to the future of AI, we'd love to have you in our growing network.

If Interested, kindly send your resume at:.

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

Competitive compensation commensurate with experience Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NÓS AJUDAMOS AS PESSOAS A ATINGIR SEUS OBJETIVOS NO MERCADO FINANCEIRO! TOPA VIR COM A GENTE?

Somos uma fintech que une tecnologia e inovação em um mercado que não para de crescer!

Desde 2019, o aplicativo Grana simplifica o cálculo de Imposto de Renda para investidores da bolsa. Hoje, estamos expandindo nossa atuação com novos produtos:

Grana Pro, voltado para contadores e assessores que atendem investidores; Grana Smart, que utiliza Open Finance e Inteligência Artificial para dar mais clareza e controle sobre a vida financeira das pessoas.

Estamos em um momento de construção e crescimento, abrindo novas frentes, testando caminhos e evoluindo nossos produtos com base em quem usa.

Conheça mais sobre nossa proposta e funcionalidades em:

O Grana Pro é nossa frente B2 B e está em fase de construção. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na linha de frente desse crescimento, ajudando a desenvolver e escalar a base de clientes.

Essa posição envolve desde a prospecção e apresentação do produto até o acompanhamento do cliente ao longo da jornada, com um papel ativo na construção da estratégia comercial e na evolução do produto.

Aqui, você terá autonomia, contato direto com o mercado e a oportunidade real de construir algo do zero.

Se isso te descreve, essa vaga é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Mapear e prospectar ativamente contadores e assessores — levantamento de mercado, abordagem por e-mail, Linked In, Whats App e telefone, campanhas de marketing; Apresentar o produto em demonstrações por vídeo ou presencialmente, conectando as funcionalidades às dores reais de cada cliente; Acompanhar o funil de ponta a ponta, analisar a conversão e propor ações concretas para melhorar os números; Fazer o acompanhamento pós-venda, garantir que o cliente use o produto e vire referência; Dar retorno direto sobre o produto com base no que vê no dia a dia;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência em vendas consultivas ou gestão de contas B2 B; Facilidade para entender e explicar produtos com alguma complexidade (fiscal, tributária ou financeira); Perfil que constrói carteira de clientes do zero, sem esperar o contato chegar; Boa comunicação escrita e verbal; Capacidade de olhar a estratégia ampla para definir caminhos e, ao mesmo tempo, se envolver nos detalhes operacionais. Mentalidade \"0 a 1\": perfil auto-motivado que tenha paixão por construir e vontade de desenvolver uma prática de vendas B2 B do zero.

Será um diferencial:

Conhecimento pessoal ou profissional em investimentos (especialmente bolsa de valores); Experiência com contadores e assessores de contabilidade.

title: Technical project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical project manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.

About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations. Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities. Track progress and make sure work is moving forward. Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early. Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps. Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations. Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups. Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented. Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication. Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews. Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution. Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role. Experience working with software engineering teams. Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement. Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases. Strong communication and organization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities. Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps. Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, Git Hub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.

Required Skills

ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience. Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk. Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations. Basic SQL knowledge. Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company. Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps. Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination. Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision. Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates. Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly. Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Líder técnico iii (react native/nodejs)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder técnico iii (react native/nodejs) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar com liderança técnica de projetos de software, no Inatel Competence Center - ICC.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software; Atuar na definição de soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade e desempenho; Definir, documentar e validar arquiteturas lógicas e executáveis de sistemas; Elaborar documentação técnica, arquitetural, operacional e de apoio à gestão dos projetos; Realizar especificação funcional e técnica de sistemas e aplicações; Prover soluções e suporte ao desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicativos móveis e web; Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível de complexidade técnica; Atuar em conjunto com o time de QA, apoiando estratégias de testes e qualidade; Revisar códigos-fonte, garantindo aderência a boas práticas, padrões de projeto e qualidade de software; Projetar soluções com foco em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD); Atuar como referência técnica, promovendo capacitação, mentoria e suporte aos desenvolvedores; Planejar, acompanhar e monitorar as atividades técnicas dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade; Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à evolução do projeto, arquitetura e infraestrutura.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia, tais como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software;

Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando React Native, Expo e Node.js;

Vivência com:

Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares); Atuação em ambientes com cultura Dev Ops. Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis e aplicações web; Design e definição de arquitetura de aplicações móveis e backend; Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais; Desenvolvimento e consumo de Web Services e APIs REST; Aplicação de Design Patterns e boas práticas de engenharia de software; Modelagem e documentação de projetos; Ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex.: Git) e análise de qualidade de código;

Atuação prévia com AWS (Amazon Web Services), incluindo:

Conceitos de arquitetura em nuvem; Uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS/Dynamo DB, Lambda, API Gateway e Cloud Watch; Boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade; Apoio à definição de pipelines e ambientes em nuvem.

Forte atuação com:

Comunicação Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE); Comunicação em rede CAN; Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play; Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para build, testes e deploy; Testes automatizados; Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design.

Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 17h30.

Local de Trabalho: as atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

Here at Zallpy, technology is born from curious, collaborative people with a desire to do things well. If you like environments where there's room to ask questions, test, learn, and evolve together, check out this opportunity!

We also encourage Black people, women, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and professionals from diverse backgrounds to apply.

Here, growth means sharing knowledge, respecting different ways of thinking, and building trusting relationships while delivering quality technology. If you identify with this way of working, come join us.

What you will do:

Develop technical solutions that meet the requirements presented using the technologies involved in the project; Work within agile team structures based on Agile methodologies, with intense information exchange; Participate in ceremonies for defining the product backlog for Sprints, as well as Dailies, Reviews, and Retrospectives; Keep task boards updated regarding pending tasks, ongoing activities, and possible blockers; Use the company's communication tools to stay updated on schedules, alignments, and team discussions; Deliver code covered by unit and integration tests; Submit Pull Requests for team review.

Nice to have:

Experience working with basic Cloud services (EC2, S3, RDS); Advanced knowledge of Design Patterns, including SOLID, Clean Code, etc.; Experience creating and managing Cloud Services (AWS, Azure); Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform, Consul, AWS, Azure, or similar technologies; Previous experience as a Tech Lead or Software Architect; Experience with database migration between Mongo DB and Postgre SQL.

This is a 100% remote position.

CLT Cooperative

title: Latam decom project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Latam decom project manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp's diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company's mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

About the Role

The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.

Responsibilities

Program & Project Delivery

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations. Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control. Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions. Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.

Vendor & MSP Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services. Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs. Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines. Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs. Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.

Delivery Governance & Compliance

Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers. Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).

Reporting & Metrics

Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations. Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.

Qualifications

8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments. Experience working with or within hyperscalers. Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations. Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds. Proficiency with PM tools. Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills. Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.

Preferred Skills

PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications. Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.
