title: Médico gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico gastroenterologista em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais. Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde; Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Customer success manager (br)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer success manager (br) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a FULL-TIME Customer Success Manager to be the main point of contact between our customers and our technical team.

This is a 100% remote position - you'll work from home in your own country. (No relocation.)

CLEAR, CONFIDENT ENGLISH IS OUR #1 REQUIREMENT.

You will be speaking directly with our US-based customers on live calls, demos, and video meetings, so you need to communicate comfortably and be easily understood in real time.

We will do a short video call early in the process - for this role, that conversation matters more than anything on your resume.

No programming or technical background is required. You do not need to be a developer.

We will fully train you on our system, our industry (primarily oil and natural gas), and our software tools. You will be paid your normal salary during training.

What you will do:

Respond to customer support tickets - professionally and promptly. Present product demos to potential customers (we set up and schedule these - you walk them through it). Run weekly status meetings with our support and development team to make sure customer issues are handled properly and on time. Be the organized, reliable person who keeps things moving and follows through.

What we are looking for:

Excellent spoken and written English. Strong organization and follow-through. Comfortable talking with customers and presenting. Professional, calm, and genuinely good with people. A self-starter who makes sure things get done.

Our Company is Deep Fork Automation, and you will join a team of 10 (most of whom are international remote workers).

We work in Automation, SCADA and Remote Monitoring.

You will be paid in US Dollars. On top of monthly salary, we include National holidays off, Paid Time Off, and other benefits.

Additionally, we have annual performance reviews with raises and bonuses.

Your schedule will follow US business hours so you can support our customers and coordinate with the team.

We hope this works out and can become a very long term employment opportunity.

If this is you, please apply!

title: Senior treasury analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior treasury analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.

The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)

• Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.

• Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.

• Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.

• Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.

• Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.

• Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.

• Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.

• Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.

• Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.

• Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.

• Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.

Cash Management & Treasury Operations

• Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.

• Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.

• Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.

• Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.

• Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.

• Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.

• Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.

• Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.

• Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.

• Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.

• Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization.

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.

• Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

• Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.

• Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.

• Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.

• Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.

• Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Languages

• Advanced English (required).

• Intermediate Spanish (desirable).

Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Virtual executive assistant – family owned business group em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production.

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts. We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries, gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities Serve as a primary communication liaison, screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel Prepare meeting materials, agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers, including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized Assist with special projects, including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries Highly resourceful and high-agency, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets), Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup Availability to work during overlapping U. S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required) Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

Competitive compensation commensurate with experience Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment Exposure to a diversified business portfolio, not a single company role Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em desenvolvimento de negócios (b2b) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NÓS AJUDAMOS AS PESSOAS A ATINGIR SEUS OBJETIVOS NO MERCADO FINANCEIRO! TOPA VIR COM A GENTE?

Somos uma fintech que une tecnologia e inovação em um mercado que não para de crescer!

Desde 2019, o aplicativo Grana simplifica o cálculo de Imposto de Renda para investidores da bolsa. Hoje, estamos expandindo nossa atuação com novos produtos:

Grana Pro, voltado para contadores e assessores que atendem investidores; Grana Smart, que utiliza Open Finance e Inteligência Artificial para dar mais clareza e controle sobre a vida financeira das pessoas.

Estamos em um momento de construção e crescimento, abrindo novas frentes, testando caminhos e evoluindo nossos produtos com base em quem usa.

Conheça mais sobre nossa proposta e funcionalidades em:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

O Grana Pro é nossa frente B2 B e está em fase de construção. Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar na linha de frente desse crescimento, ajudando a desenvolver e escalar a base de clientes.

Essa posição envolve desde a prospecção e apresentação do produto até o acompanhamento do cliente ao longo da jornada, com um papel ativo na construção da estratégia comercial e na evolução do produto.

Aqui, você terá autonomia, contato direto com o mercado e a oportunidade real de construir algo do zero.

Se isso te descreve, essa vaga é para você!

Mapear e prospectar ativamente contadores e assessores — levantamento de mercado, abordagem por e-mail, Linked In, Whats App e telefone, campanhas de marketing; Apresentar o produto em demonstrações por vídeo ou presencialmente, conectando as funcionalidades às dores reais de cada cliente; Acompanhar o funil de ponta a ponta, analisar a conversão e propor ações concretas para melhorar os números; Fazer o acompanhamento pós-venda, garantir que o cliente use o produto e vire referência; Dar retorno direto sobre o produto com base no que vê no dia a dia;

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência em vendas consultivas ou gestão de contas B2 B; Facilidade para entender e explicar produtos com alguma complexidade (fiscal, tributária ou financeira); Perfil que constrói carteira de clientes do zero, sem esperar o contato chegar; Boa comunicação escrita e verbal; Capacidade de olhar a estratégia ampla para definir caminhos e, ao mesmo tempo, se envolver nos detalhes operacionais. Mentalidade \"0 a 1\": perfil auto-motivado que tenha paixão por construir e vontade de desenvolver uma prática de vendas B2 B do zero.

Será um diferencial:

Conhecimento pessoal ou profissional em investimentos (especialmente bolsa de valores); Experiência com contadores e assessores de contabilidade.

Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter focus)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Flutter focus) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence.
  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment.
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Nice to have:

  • Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows.
  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral

  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:

  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation

description:

Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

description:

Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities

  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed

  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technology Manager (Licensed Entities) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Senior Software Engineer (Flutter focus)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Flutter focus) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role Description:

Headspace is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack with Flutter focus) to support our Employer Solutions team. This team builds the foundational capabilities that power our commercial partnerships by enabling hundreds of employers to offer Headspace as a benefit to their workforce. This assignment supports development and delivery of scalable, high-quality mobile systems and features, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with our backend services and bring Headspace’s mission to life.


Deliverables:

  • Design and develop maintainable and flexible services for mission-critical systems that directly support mental healthcare delivery.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to gather requirements and write RFCs and technical specifications to solve technical and business problems end to end.
  • Effectively communicate technical ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Use business and technical knowledge to recommend thoughtful tradeoffs between complexity, quality, and delivery speed.
  • Maintain high standards for documentation, code quality, code reviews and operational excellence.
  • Contribute to and influence system architecture decisions, product quality and SLA targets.
  • Apply best practices in testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience developing with Flutter, including familiarity with Flutter frameworks, third-party libraries, and APIs.
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, with a strong understanding of design patterns.
  • Proficiency with mobile architecture and design patterns (e.g., MVC, MVVM).
  • Experience designing reliable, scalable microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency with Git version control systems and other essential mobile development tools.
  • Experience writing robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge-case handling, using API testing frameworks/tools (e.g., Jest, Gatling, Playwright).
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a fast-paced, Agile environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively partner with product managers, designers, and engineers in a remote-friendly environment.
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across product and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders aligned.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Nice to have:

  • Experience with native mobile development (Android and/or iOS), including the respective SDKs and app release workflows.
  • Experience with AWS and working with databases.
  • Experience with SDUI and CI/CD.
  • Experience with flutter_bloc.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Lead/Community Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Python/Cloud Platform Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.
